review_text: The new store look is a great upgrade, but the service counter layout needs a rethink. The small service window facing the bus bay makes it difficult for customers to order and collect their food comfortably. Since this branch primarily caters to travelers, faster service and a more accessible counter are essential to help passengers avoid missing their trips.

I had a really disappointing experience at Dunkin' Donuts in the terminal this morning. Around 7 AM, I was simply trying to clarify my order, but instead of being helpful, the cashier immediately lashed out at me. She was overly defensive and rude when there was absolutely no reason for it. Customer service should be about being accommodating, especially for something as simple as a clarification. Instead, I was met with attitude that completely ruined the start of my day. Honestly, if you're going to treat customers like that, maybe this kind of job isn't for you. Ate, wag ka na magtrabaho if ganyan ugali at itsura mo. I hope the manager or much more the owner will see this. Lol. May balik yan Ate.

I am very disappointed with this staff because I bought a few days ago on April 22, 2026 at 5am. I handed over 1000 pesos and they said they had no change because they had just cashed it out but there were only 50 bills. So I gave them another 100 pesos and they still hadn't returned my 1000 bill until they took me to the store next door. When I got back, they only handed me the donuts and the money was gone. When I was sitting on the bus, I counted my money and it was 1k short. I went back to them and they counted the money twice. At first, they said they didn't have change but there was a lot. Then they said they had enough money but they were laughing while talking to me. If I hadn't been in a hurry, the bus I took was leaving. I would have had a lot more to say because the woman guarding the store was really dishonest. I counted my money before buying and she was the only one I bought 1k from. It was like I just lost my 1k. Then I would buy something worth 329 told me that there was no change, no matter how much money he had in his pocket, he was really interested in my money, so God will take care of him!
